author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ruling, 2026-11-13: tooth 2 of cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/proofs/test_a_cairn_spawn_opens_no_console_window.py is a deterministic red on Windows, 2 of 2 reruns alone. Measured: the tree under the spawned venv python.exe is [python.exe launcher, python.exe base interpreter, conhost.exe whose parent is the base interpreter]; detached_kwargs() already passes DETACHED_PROCESS|CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP, but the venv launcher re-spawns the base interpreter without them and the base interpreter allocates a console. Measured the same day: the same spawn through pythonw.exe beside the venv python leaves [pythonw.exe, pythonw.exe] and no conhost at t=2 s, but the launcher pythonw exits at once (poll 0) while the real child runs on, and sys.stdout is None in a pythonw child.
